chunks: From him, from Nūḥ ibn Shuʿayb and Abū Isḥāq al-Khaffāf, from a man, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

There is nothing for the sincere ones among our Shi'a in the rule of falsehood except sustenance enough to live on. Go east if you wish, or go west; you will not be provided except with sustenance enough to live on.

key_terms.الْقُوتُ: bare sustenance, the minimum food or provision needed to live
key_terms.تُرْزَقُوا: you will be provided or granted sustenance
key_terms.دَوْلَةِ الْبَاطِلِ: the regime or rule founded upon falsehood
key_terms.شِيعَتِنَا: our Shi'a, the followers devoted to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.مُصَاصِ: the purest or most sincere ones

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the livelihood of the sincere Shi'a under false rule?
ai.summary: The hadith states that the sincere Shi'a, while living under the rule of falsehood, should not expect more than basic sustenance. It emphasizes the constricted worldly provision allotted to them in such conditions, no matter where they turn.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Nuh Bin Shuayb and Abu Is’haq Al Khaffaf, from A man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘There is nothing for our<sup>asws</sup> sincere Shia in the government of the falsehood except for the bare necessities. They can go east if they so like to, or west, they will never be Graced except with the bare necessities’.
en.sarwar: 7. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Nuh ibn Shu’ayb and abu Ishaq al-Khaffaf from a man from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “For our pure Shi’a (followers) there is nothing under the rule of the unjust power more than bare necessities.
Westernize or Easternize, you will never gain more than bare necessities.”
